symbols.L_i: complete Ethernet frame payload length at virtio boundary, including Ethernet header but excluding virtio header; exact input not yet frozen
symbols.s_i: source/destination contiguous spans necessary for frame i
symbols.q_A/q_B: actual posted queue capacity, unknown until next input/allocations
symbols.N_A/N_B: finite frame count per direction, unknown; source burst32 is a bound, not a mandatory count

useful_bytes_formula: sum_i L_i; per-destination receive record contains H+L_i; every accepted byte checked; no forced_min_copy_size

ordinary_payload_traffic.original_staged: A→host→B: read 2*sum(L_i), write 2*sum(L_i), if both payload copies DMA
ordinary_payload_traffic.direct_CPU_or_DMA: A→B: read sum(L_i), write sum(L_i); DMA-unique IOMMU traffic exists only for DMA path
ordinary_payload_traffic.not_in_payload_total: Guest header/descriptor/used metadata, source preparation, destination consumer reads, cache operations, page tables and DMA descriptors must be counted separately

finite_projection_budget.rule: No larger than source burst/vector bounds per admission batch; choose actual finite packet prefix and exact capacity sufficient for it without inflating translation pressure. Source+destination+optional staging+metadata+page tables+alignment+allocator rounding all reported. Use CPU/single-DMA savings and any legal whole-pool large leaves.
finite_projection_budget.allocation_formula: sum allocated source capacities + sum posted destination capacities + optional retained host staging + headers + packet/descriptor/cookie metadata + mapping/page-table/allocator overhead

cost_items.name: prepare
cost_items.obligation: Generate/load actual complete frames; guest source construction, routing metadata, valid destination buffers; include any fixture conversion separately.

cost_items.name: allocation
cost_items.obligation: Source/destination/staging pools, alignment/rounding, metadata, failed large-page allocation, pinned/resident footprint.

cost_items.name: mapping
cost_items.obligation: Initial host IOVA/domain maps, page tables and real leaf sizes; retained mapping allowed; invalidation only when required.

cost_items.name: supply
cost_items.obligation: CPU parsing/routing, segmentation, descriptor fetch, MMIO address/length setup, successful trigger/handshake and batching.

cost_items.name: payload
cost_items.obligation: Exactly actual direct or staged transfer bytes; include CPU copy in CPU baseline, no forced duplicate staging.

cost_items.name: completion
cost_items.obligation: Poll IDs/status/errors, final no-pending check, record all bytes/packets; DONE not sufficient for content success.

cost_items.name: cache
cost_items.obligation: Actual platform cache ownership transition per finite phase; CPU alternative pays only its own needed operations.

cost_items.name: consumer
cost_items.obligation: Used/header publication, descriptor-cookie resolution, every frame byte/length/order check or real consumer, guard check, final source-reuse independence.

cost_items.name: drain
cost_items.obligation: All in-flight engines and descriptors complete or quarantined, no buffer released while referenced.

cost_items.name: conversion
cost_items.obligation: Cold start, switching CPU/DMA modes, queue reconfiguration and any mapping changes separately from steady state.

cost_items.name: release
cost_items.obligation: Guest consumer completion, return slots, unmap/invalidations/final allocation release.

cost_items.name: adaptation
cost_items.obligation: Finite packet software glue, its code/metadata and measured runtime; no free full DPDK/QEMU port.

measurement_scope.source_delivery: Actual useful delivery ends only after correct data/header/used ordering and guest-consumer ownership is established; final release/drain is separately reported and included in full lifecycle accounting.
measurement_scope.validation_observer: Every-byte comparisons, guard scans, trace/counter collection and source-reuse checking are validation/instrumentation overhead, not automatically native guest application computation. Record their wall time/access bytes separately while retaining total observed execution cost.
measurement_scope.comparison: Report prepare/execute/publication/consumer-visible/validator/drain/release scopes. Do not subtract or invent unmeasured components, or charge CPU DMA-only barriers.
